Long St. ... (620) 397-5541'; the 'Lane County Fair' slide links to the Lane County Lions Club Facebook page.

RV Life park 261742 'Lane County Fairgrounds', Dighton KS (Algolia + reviews API, 2026-11-05): 5 stars from 3 reviews, price_level 1, avg_rate 20. Reviews: 9/2023 fifth wheel, '$20 USD', site 11 back-in, 'hooking up electric, water, and sewer. 50 amp power'; 9/2022 '$20 USD', 'Full hook up for $20 ... just needed an overnight stop, it is just off the highway'; 3/2022 '$20 USD', 'Full Hookups at the fairground ... a fairground rv park'.

Google Maps 'Lane County Fairgrounds', 745 7th St, Dighton (2026-11-05): 4.0 from 22 reviews, phone (620) 397-5391, website dightonkansas.com; reviews mention 'parking for the RV w/hook ups' and fair use, nothing on rates, fair-week closure or harvest crews.

Esri World Imagery at the stored pin 38.49096,-100.47646 (250 m half) and 38.4905,-100.4800 (200 m half), 2026-11-05: the pin is on the gravel road at the fairgrounds' east edge by the racetrack; two short rows of posts with parked trailers/RVs sit in the fairgrounds' NW corner at ~38.4917,-100.4804, ~350 m WNW of the pin.
note: Lane County fairgrounds RV area; two rows of full-hookup sites with 50-amp electric, water and sewer, dump, pet-friendly. Check in at the public works building or use the dropbox. --Claude
summary: No operator page: the City of Dighton site has no RV/fairground camping content, TravelKS refused. RV Life camper reports (2022-2023, $20 full hookup, 50 amp, overnight travellers in March and September) support the stored hookups; no 2024+ dated rate. No field changes. Pin ~350 m off the RV rows.
flags: WEAK: no operator or agency page describes the RV sites. The only evidence of transient nights outside the fair is RV Life reviews by passing fifth-wheel travellers (3/2022, 9/2022, 9/2023, each '$20 USD' full hookup); the inclusion_evidence cites TravelKS, which refused me (403). Whether the sites close or are reserved during the Lane County Fair (summer) is not stated anywhere I could read.
FEES: no rate stored and none dated 2024+; the camper-reported $20 full hookup is 2022-2023, older than the 2024 camper-report window, so not written.
PIN MOVE: stored 38.49096,-100.47646 is the gravel road at the east edge of the fairgrounds; the RV rows (posts with parked trailers) are in the NW corner at ~38.4917,-100.4804, ~350 m WNW.

PHONE: stored 620-397-5541 is the City of Dighton office (the inclusion evidence says check in at public works). Google lists (620) 397-5391 for the fairgrounds; I could not tell whose line that is. WEBSITE https://dightonkansas.com/ is the city site with no camping content - weak.
